## Why visit

One of the clearest cider-led excursions from Liverpool. CAMRA’s local branch documents a substantial rotating real-cider offer as well as a broad cask selection, and names it its 2026 cider winner. The former bank premises provide an informal neighbourhood setting rather than a heritage showpiece. It works particularly well as a stop on the Southport line combined with the Guest House or Tap & Bottles, giving the day both traditional pub rooms and a focused drinks selection with plenty to compare.
